verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is a chat-first AI assistant. Users drive it in natural language to query documents and invoke AI agents, which can run web scraping/search, custom agent skills, agent flows and MCP tools. Most of this evidence is feature headings rather than in-depth descriptions of natural-language command execution. Missing for 10: evidence that product configuration and admin tasks can be done via natural language, detailed docs on how agents are invoked from chat, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent command execution.
